mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file (path, stored_name, original_name, size, ext, description, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{path}, #{storedName}, #{originalName}, #{size}, #{ext}, #{description}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND original_name LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'
SELECT file_id, path, stored_name, original_name, size, ext, description, use_yn FROM file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE file SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
UPDATE file SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND file_id IN ( SELECT file_id FROM file_ref WHERE map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND file_type IN #{loc} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, path, stored_name, use_yn FROM file f WHERE (f.use_yn = 'N' AND f.upd_dt < NOW() - make_interval(days => #{retentionDays})) OR (f.use_yn = 'Y' AND f.reg_dt < NOW() - make_interval(hours => #{abandonHours}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM file_ref r WHERE r.file_id = f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member u WHERE u.profile_file_id = f.file_id))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND profile_file_id = #{fileId}::integer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND file_id = #{fileId}::integer AND reg_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_ref WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer

SELECT f.file_id, f.original_name, f.ext, f.size, f.description, r.file_type, r.sort_no FROM file_ref r JOIN file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND r.file_type = #{fileType} ORDER BY r.sort_no, f.file_id
SELECT file_type, map_key::TEXT AS map_key FROM file_ref WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
SELECT reg_id FROM post WHERE post_id = #{mapKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE file SET description = #{description} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM file_ref WHERE map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND file_type = #{fileType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_ref (map_key, file_id, file_type, sort_no) VALUES (#{mapKey}::integer, #{fileId}::integer, #{fileType}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0))
